lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, I'm here for immigration. Which line should I join?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you a visitor or a resident?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm a visitor. I'm here for a trip.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you can join the line on the left, for visitors.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Do I need to fill out any forms?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, you don't need any forms. Just have your passport ready.
